mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% indicates a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deceleration in labor market growth (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals an economic slowdown, reducing corporate profit expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint negative movement of PAYEMS and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve delays rate cuts, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units signals reduced consumer confidence and construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1300, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deceleration in GDP growth (GDPC1) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates stagflation, causing corporate profit margin pressure and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of GDPC1 deceleration and CPIAUCSL > 3.5% fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime (HOUST > 1400 thousand units), the market becomes overvalued on housing-related sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corrections occur.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1400, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.
